what: One-round extension of the 41-active-S-box 4-round Ascon-p characteristic of L. Sotomayor (profile 14-11-9-7, weight 125) to 5 rounds. Rounds 1-3 and the round-4 input are unchanged; only the round-4 S-box output in column 21 changes (00001 -> 11000 instead of 00001 -> 01001). Words are x0..x4, 16 hex digits each; S-box index x0 = most significant bit.

source.note: Rounds 1-3 are taken unchanged from this file. Its author checks it with verify.py and a conforming pair; we have not yet re-checked rounds 1-3 ourselves (job ascon-ext-v1 does).

round5_min_search: exhaustive over all 8^7 = 2097152 DDT-compatible round-4 outputs (test_ascon_extend.py)
round5_output_rule: column value a -> S(0) xor S(a), always DDT-compatible
